scope: Forearm-bouquet-hand depth ordering and dual-wrist bouquet binding
summary: v17 fixed the forearm/flower/hand depth order, but binding the flower to the mean of both wrists produced zero hand-flower overlap in some frames when the hands separated.
evidence: final/manifest.json records mean hand occlusion 2309 pixels but minimum hand occlusion 0 pixels.
assets/review-frame-0250.png confirms the corrected flowers-before-hands layer order.
lessons: A manipulated object should follow its holding hand, not the midpoint of both hands.
limitations: The bouquet could float between separated hands despite correct scale and layer order.
next_actions: Bind the bouquet grip anchor inside the holding hand while keeping the other hand independent.
